record_identity.title: Human-directed Cairn agents performed a large-scale website intrusion campaign

incident_identity.historical_event_name: Cairn AIA0001 website intrusion campaign, late September–October 2026
incident_identity.date_basis: NorForge observed campaign activity from late September through its 19 October publication; exact earliest and latest actions remain unverified.

summary: From late September into October 2026, a Chinese-language threat actor used the Cairn AI agent orchestration system to target ecommerce and other commercial websites. NorForge examined 14 exposed dashboards linked to this activity, covering more than 1,100 attack projects. Human operators assigned targets and objectives such as obtaining unauthorised access and installing web shells. Agents worked through vulnerability discovery and exploitation, sometimes for many hours. NorForge independently verified that an uploader web shell identified by one project was live on a hardware-parts vendor's server. Reuters separately reported apparent breaches affecting more than 100 sites, including some associated with large companies, whose confirmed consequences differed. NorForge reported that exposed agent consoles contained hundreds of secrets, with some verified as active. The human operators, rather than the agents, supplied the unlawful goals.

vigil_assessment.factual_basis: NorForge directly examined exposed Cairn panel records and an identified live uploader endpoint. Its AIA0001 cluster consists of 14 associated dashboards with more than 1,100 projects; project count does not equal successful compromise or unique victims. Reuters independently obtained affected-company responses with differing confirmed exposure scopes. NorForge's secrets-scan result concerned multiple exposed panels, including other activity clusters, not exclusively AIA0001. The study does not provide a verified confidential data-loss inventory for every target.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The operator supplied the objective, while agents materially selected and executed intrusion pathways. The verified installation establishes more than speculative capability. The operator’s objective did not supply the affected website owner’s permission. This supports an authority finding without asserting that the agents invented the malicious purpose or manipulated a reward. The confirmed asset alteration supports a minimum harm band; wider loss remains unresolved. NorForge verified that the reported web-shell uploader was live on a real vendor’s server. This establishes an unauthorised information-integrity operation on that host. It does not establish every dashboard objective or data theft at all apparent victims. The broader panel-secret sample is not attributed wholesale to this actor.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: This case distinguishes human misuse, long-duration autonomous execution, independently verified intrusion and downstream confidentiality effects. It avoids conflating a campaign with a particular victim's complete damage.
assessment_boundaries: Human-directed crime is not evidence of the AI independently generating the illicit goal.
Site-by-site affected population, financial loss and actual credential leakage not consistently published.
The 11% valid-secret metric spans examined panels and is not specifically attributed to the AIA0001 cluster; do not score this incident from that total.

clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Operator-selected objectives and agent execution must retain separate responsibility attribution.

clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Autonomous execution scale alone does not establish the model replaced a valid instruction with an independently illicit objective.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The agent workflow selected and continued exploitation steps towards the operator’s access goal. The verified external installation anchors this interpretation; project counts alone do not.

clauses.source_paraphrase: NorForge verified that a web-shell uploader reported by one project was active on a real vendor website.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A concrete unauthorised external system alteration is evidenced for at least one target.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The agents pursued the operator’s intrusion objective through unauthorised installation on a real third-party site. clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A campaign count must not be converted into uniform victim injury or confidential data exposure.

preferred_evidence.selection_basis: Direct investigative evidence where possible, or the closest publicly reviewable contemporaneous attributed report; unsupported motives excluded.

external_requirement_assessments.assessment_basis: The operator directed agents towards unauthorised access and the workflow produced a verified external installation. Access was operationally organised around intrusion rather than bounded to admissible targets. This finding concerns the operator-controlled deployment, not all providers or legitimate Cairn users.
external_requirement_assessments.identification_basis: Independent review of the registered proposition against the evidenced actor, system, activity and lifecycle. Voluntary alignment is separate from adoption, certification and legal applicability.

external_requirement_assessments.assessment_basis: The operator-controlled deployment materially executed intentional misuse against third-party sites. Its observed governance did not constrain that use through protective oversight. This is scoped to the malicious operation and does not assert that every underlying model provider lacked safeguards.
external_requirement_assessments.identification_basis: Independent review of the registered proposition against the evidenced actor, system, activity and lifecycle. Voluntary alignment is separate from adoption, certification and legal applicability.

external_requirement_assessments.assessment_basis: The access-enforcement proposition requires approved logical-access authorisations to be enforced for information and system resources. The observed information operation was outside the approved boundary. NorForge independently verified a web-shell uploader on a real vendor server. That is an unauthorised file modification on the target, distinct from an unverified dashboard claim or a public read. This is a bounded retrospective comparison with the selected control proposition, not a claim of certification or an independently binding historical duty.

aggregate_harm_screening.rationale: A particular compromised website and actual persisted alteration are assessed. Campaign size is not a population harm multiplier.

harm_impact_assessment.coverage_note: All twelve dimensions reviewed. Confirmed persisted third-party alteration supports the asset-integrity S2 minimum. This is not a finding that total harm was only minor. Higher asset loss, confidential data exposure, service interruption and financial loss remain unquantified.
